description: This file defines the class actionComputeField, which extends actionBase, and handles dynamic calculation of fields within the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for loading JavaScript, running compute actions based on formulas, resolving parameters, handling related entities, and rendering UI components for configuring compute fields.

classes.name: actionComputeField
classes.description: A class that extends actionBase to handle formula-based field computations within SuiteCRM, including resolving parameters, handling related records, and generating UI for configuration.

methods.name: loadJS
methods.description: Returns the JavaScript file path necessary for the compute field functionality.

methods.name: run_action
methods.description: Executes the formula calculation and updates the bean's fields accordingly, optionally saving the changes.

methods.name: resolveParameters
methods.description: Resolves input parameters based on their type (raw or formatted) for formula calculations.

methods.name: getMultiEnumTranslated
methods.description: Translates multi-enum field values into human-readable strings.

methods.name: getArrayFromParams
methods.description: Extracts an array of values for a given key from the parameters array.

methods.name: resolveRelationParameters
methods.description: Resolves related entity fields for use in formulas, handling loaded relationships and entity types.

methods.name: getAllRelatedFields
methods.description: Returns all 'relate' type fields of a bean.

methods.name: edit_display
methods.description: Generates HTML for configuring compute fields, including dropdowns and JavaScript for dynamic UI.

methods.name: getModuleFieldsDropdown
methods.description: Creates HTML options for module fields dropdown.

methods.name: getOneRelationOptions
methods.description: Generates options for selecting related modules and fields.

methods.name: getOneRelations
methods.description: Returns 'one' type relationship links from the bean.

methods.name: getRelationDefinitions
methods.description: Retrieves relationship definitions for a given relation.

methods.name: getOppositeModule
methods.description: Determines the related module in a relationship.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Handles translation of labels, modules, and relations.

methods.name: getRelationParameterFieldSelect
methods.description: Creates an HTML select element for relation parameters.

methods.name: createOptions
methods.description: Generates sorted HTML option tags from an array of options.

methods.name: createJavascriptArrayFromParams
methods.description: Converts parameter arrays into JavaScript array literals.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Generates an option element for a relation.

methods.name: getOtherModuleForRelationship
methods.description: Queries the database for relationship partner modules.
